drivers.notes: Maker page (Pioneer Italy) reproduced as a PDF by RG Sound, rgsound.it (Italian distributor status not verified; the content is the maker's own page). Italian labels: Potenza massima = max power 8000 W, Potenza d'ingresso nominale = nominal input 3000 W. Sd printed 0.0918 m2 (converted to 918 cm2). Revc 3.0 ohm on a dual 2 ohm coil: basis not printed (series would be about 4 ohm nominal). Also printed: Vd 1.413 L, Zmax 58.56 ohm, Rms 20.367 Ns/m, Cms 0.00006 m/N, Hvc 61 mm, Hag 30 mm, VC diameter 85 mm, efficiency 0.26 %. Status: discontinued (not on current Pioneer EU/US sites).

no_ts_published.note: 12 inch dual 2 ohm Champion SPL sub, discontinued. Pioneer catalogue page (hosted copy) gives 6000 W max; nominal input reported as 2500 W only by retailers, and no Pioneer page with T/S was found. Not recorded as a driver.
